dialogues.speaker: Rege
dialogues.text: Haha... Guess I must look pretty bad, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Rege
dialogues.text: There are too many things to do in town these days which require strenuous labor. I'm a little beat, so I'm just taking a rest.

dialogues.speaker: Rege
dialogues.text: I used to have someone to talk to when taking a break, but now... Forget it, best not to think about that.
